question: Does race-grouped pairwise learning improve over L133+sigmoid with the same 133 inputs?

reference.outer_fold_probability_procedure: fold-train temporal OOF sigmoid; no raw-vs-sigmoid selection

candidate.formulation: within-race all-positive-vs-all-negative pairwise linear logistic ranking
candidate.pair_generation: all positive-negative pairs plus reversed directed pairs
candidate.single_label_races: exclude from pair training and report; retain for evaluation

preprocessing.fit_scope: each outer/inner fold train runner rows only

calibration.inner_oof_rule: first 3 months train; predict next 3 months; expand by 3 months
calibration.calibrator_fit_source: outer-train inner temporal OOF runner scores and place_hit only

metrics.metric_average_grain: race macro unless explicitly named micro

PROMOTE_RACE_AWARE.ranking_fold_repetition: each primary ranking metric improves in at least 3 of 4 folds
PROMOTE_RACE_AWARE.probability_guardrail: both mean macro log loss and macro brier are no worse

CONDITIONAL: both ranking primary metrics improve on mean and in at least 3 of 4 folds, while every probability-primary relative degradation is at most 1 percent
both probability primary means are no worse, but only one ranking primary metric meets 3-of-4 fold repetition
DROP_RACE_AWARE: either ranking primary metric does not improve on mean
both ranking primary metrics fail 3-of-4 fold repetition
either probability primary relative degradation exceeds 1 percent

forbidden: additional ranker settings or hyperparameter search
